text: Planting method (របើបដាំដុះ). Long radish is direct-seeded (not transplanted). Seeds are sown in rows with spacing of roughly 20cm x 20cm, 1-2 seeds per hole, covered lightly with fine soil, then mulched with a thin layer of rice straw or similar material to help retain soil moisture and prevent surface crusting so seedlings can emerge easily. Under good conditions, germination rate is typically 70-80%.
